title: Godfrey Hirsch, Pete Fountain and Rubinoff
summary: Sal praises drummer Godfrey Hirsch, now with Pete Fountain, and tells how he quit over Rubinoff.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
